slug: 2026-02-02 Mali unveils modern Tier III data centre

facts.fact: Mali's Ministry of Communication, Digital Economy and Administration Modernisation inaugurated the Tier III National Data Centre, which the government says will provide secure hosting for the Malian state's strategic data, e-administration platforms and public digital services (stated in the future tense; inauguration reported 'over the weekend' before the 2026-02-02 article).

note: Owner aspect not recorded: the article does not state who owns the National Data Centre or that it rents to others beyond state and shared AES use.
